author: @meghsat

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API change. LlamaCppServer no longer overrides downsize(), which means it inherits the default successful no-op from WrappedServer. This is the documented contract for backends that cannot downsize. The base class contract (transitions to DOWNSIZED once, not retried while idle) is unchanged. The existing eviction_engine.cpp path that calls s->downsize() and then s->finish_downsize(ok) is unaffected.
evidence.documentation: docs/guide/configuration/multi-model.md updated to clarify that for llama.cpp, downsize is a no-op that leaves the prompt cache intact. docs/dev/backends-reference.md added a llama.cpp subsection documenting launch flags and downsize behavior (retained after @bitgamma raised a readability concern, with author citing issue #2961's documentation request). Both docs changes are accurate and helpful.
evidence.manual_release_testing: This changes server-side behavior of the eviction engine for llama.cpp backends when auto_evict=true: after a conversation goes soft-idle, the next request should report non-zero cache_tokens instead of re-prefilling. A user can reach this through the multi-model soft-idle config path with auto_evict enabled. No evidence a human exercised this path end-to-end before merge; CI covers compilation and unit tests but not this specific idle-resume sequence.
evidence.post_approval_commits: Two commits were added after @pwilkin's first approval: (1) removing the test_downsize_preserves_prompt_cache() test (in direct response to @bitgamma's review comment), and (2) a merge of main. After @bitgamma's latest approval (2026-09-14T05:01:00Z), no further commits were added. The post-approval commits were benign: removing a test and rebasing. @bitgamma re-approved on the final state.
evidence.review: PR #3565 received two substantive reviews. @pwilkin (subject area includes llamacpp per contribute.md) approved with positive confirmation. @bitgamma requested removal of the prompt-cache preservation test (calling it redundant since it tests llamacpp behavior, not Lemonade) and flagged the dev/docs addition as unclear out of context. The author removed the test script (the only substantive code change after pwilkin's first approval) and kept the dev docs with a rebuttal pointing to issue #2961's documentation request. @bitgamma then approved on the final commit (cdeeb28). The review was thorough and correctly scoped.
evidence.security: No security concerns. The change removes code (21 lines of erase-slot logic). It does not introduce network calls, credential handling, or permission changes. The only remaining path is the base-class no-op.
evidence.tests: Removed test_downsize_preserves_prompt_cache() per reviewer request. Added CACHE_TEST_CTX_SIZE constant (1024) used by the removed test and existing test_downsize_idle_timeout(). No existing tests weakened or deleted beyond the requested removal. The base-class downsize() no-op is implicitly tested by the existing eviction tests that verify state transitions.

maintainer_todos.text: Start Lemonade with auto_evict enabled and a llama.cpp model, send a prompt, wait for the model to go soft-idle, then send a follow-up prompt and confirm the /stats endpoint reports non-zero cache_tokens (the prompt prefix was reused instead of re-prefilled).

subject: fix(server): stop erasing llama.cpp slots on soft-idle downsize #2961 (#3565)
summary: Removes LlamaCppServer::downsize() override so soft-idle transitions fall through to the base-class no-op instead of issuing POST /slots?action=erase, which freed no VRAM and destroyed the prompt cache.
verdict_reason: Well-scoped bug fix with strong experimental evidence and thorough review, but the only automated test proving the fix was removed per reviewer request and no human verified the soft-idle resume path end-to-end before merge.
